newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Milacron president to retire.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Milacron president to retire.

text.p: Cincinnati Milacron Inc said on Tuesday that its president and chief operating officer Raymond Ross plans to retire at the end of the year.
Ross, who spent more than 30 years with Milacron, said he wanted to devote more time to personal projects including charitable work, the company said in a statement.
Chief executive Daniel Meyer will assume the additional title of president upon Ross' retirement, the company added.
Cincinnati Milacron produces plastics processing equipment, machine tools and industrial consumable products.
